title: POOR Construction
text: POOR Construction. This is exactly what I've been looking for to replace ones that lasted about 15 years. Upon receiving, I opened the zipper and the zipper tab came off in my fingers. Upon examination, I discovered that both ends of the zipper were unfinished. I had purchased 2 of these so I checked the other one and saw it was the same. I decided to keep them and to hand sew what was done incorrectly. These are perfect for lingerie and small delicates, but I'll be surprised if they last more than a year or 2.

product_metadata.title: Home-X 4-Section Mesh Laundry Bag, Small Divided Meshed Bag for Washing Delicates
features: DIVIDED MESH BAG: This mesh bag provides plenty of room for your delicates, including bras, underwear, blouses, scarves, small knit clothing, stockings, tank tops, lingerie, and active wear. Keep your garments separated as you wash them to avoid them snagging or catching on each other. Easily access the 4 pockets with a single zipper.

AVOID RIPS, SNAGS & TEARS: Some garments just don’t hold up very well in the washing machine or dryer, even on the gentlest settings. They come out with tears, holes, or frayed seams. This reusable bag allows you to wash and dry your favorite clothes while also protecting them. Just zip up your items and throw the whole bag into the washer or dryer.

TIGHT YET BREATHABLE WEAVE: Mesh fabric is loosely woven and often characterized by small, closely spaced holes. It is an extremely breathable fabric, which allows water or air to reach the clothing held inside. This fabric is also good at airing out dirty clothes, so you can also use this organizer as a dirty clothes hamper until your garments can be washed.

MULTI-PURPOSE STORAGE: Our bag is good for more than just washing your clothes. You can also use the mesh bag for storage. It’s the perfect size to organize socks and underwear or to fit into your suitcase, duffel bag, or travel tote. Try using this bag as an everyday organizer in your closet, laundry room, dresser drawer, or bathroom.

QUALITY CONSTRUCTION: We designed this white mesh bag to be used for many washes to come. Mesh is an extremely durable fabric that won’t disappoint. Men and women alike will love how well this zippered laundry bag keeps their fine clothing protected during cleaning. Once you try it out, you won’t want to wash your delicates any other way!
description: Washing some pieces of clothing can be a hassle! Hosiery gets tangled up in other clothes, the clips on bra straps snag sweaters, and blouses might come out with tears because of the fine fabric. But washing clothes doesn’t have to be so difficult! We have designed an easy solution so that you can wash all of your clothing together without worry. This mesh bag features 4 compartments, allowing you to sort and wash a variety of garments at once. Put your socks in one compartment and athletic clothing in another. This feature keeps clothing protected so you can avoid tears, snags, rips, and other damage. Mesh allows water to pass through the bag and reach your clothing, so they get clean in your washing machine. Likewise, air can pass through the closely spaced holes to dry your clothes. Throw the laundry holder into your washing machine or dryer along with the rest of your load. The durable fabric will last for many washes to come, making washing, drying, and folding your clothes a lot easier. But that’s not all this bag can do! You can use it for home organization as well. Store baby or kids clothing, transport your workout clothing in your gym bag, or organize small craft supplies or other accessories. Use the sectional bag for neatly packing your suitcase on your next vacation! The different pockets let you separate clean and dirty laundry as you travel. Plus, the bag is small enough to store in your closet or dresser drawer. Get your laundry mesh bag today and treat your delicates the way they deserve to be treated!
